comment: Oscillator 3's detune is added to oscillator 2's already detuned pitch (wavetable-oscillator.cpp:351), not to the main pitch as docs/wave.md says; with oscillator 2 detuned, oscillator 3 moves with it. The maker's tooltips are wrong in two places: all three capture inputs are configured as 'Top capture' (:89-91) and oscillator 3's position CV input is configured as 'Osc 2 wavetable position CV' (:114). Input 6, the SYNC jack, has no configInput at all, so hovering it shows no name. The mirror button and the MIRROR trigger input share one dsp::SchmittTrigger (:296-297), so a voltage held above 1V at that jack stops the button working.
